_comment: Unattended scheduler config. OFF by default. restart.enabled requires the Pelican client-API panel variables (DUNE_PELICAN_URL / DUNE_PELICAN_CLIENT_KEY / DUNE_PELICAN_SERVER_ID) — without them the restart task self-skips with a logged note. When a restart slot is due the server broadcasts an in-game countdown (warn_lead_secs) then the panel API restarts the container (a clean stop saves state). backup runs pg_dump of the dune DB to /home/container/backups every backup.every_hours, keeping backup.retention newest. Edit this file + restart, or use the Tasks tab / GET-POST /api/schedule. Times are UTC; days are mon..sun.
